description: Cancel a pending delayed referral trigger for a participant before the delay elapses (e.g. on refund/cancellation). Returns { success, message }. Targets `campaignId` if you pass it, otherwise GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID.

campaignId.description: Target program (campaign) id for this call. Defaults to GROWSURF_CAMPAIGN_ID when omitted. Pass the `id` returned by growsurf_create_campaign to configure or operate a program you just created, without restarting the server.

name: growsurf_cancel_delayed_referral

message.description: Human-readable result message. Present when credit was not awarded immediately.

success.description: Whether referral credit was awarded, scheduled, or cancelled.

title: Cancel Delayed Referral
